description: This file defines the DocumentRepository class which manages database operations (CRUD) for Document objects, including methods for finding, inserting, updating, and deleting documents in a MySQL database.

classes.name: DocumentRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing Document persistence in a MySQL database, extending MysqlRepository and implementing Deletable interface.

methods.name: findByParentId
methods.description: Retrieves documents based on a parent type and optional parent ID.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Fetches a document by its unique ID.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Deletes a document identified by its ID from the database.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new Document object into the database.

methods.name: getBaseSelectQueryBuilder
methods.description: Constructs the base SQL select query builder with joins and default columns for retrieving documents.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves all documents from the database.

methods.name: updateById
methods.description: Updates specific columns of a document by its ID.
